mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.2% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.2% in a month, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (indicated by INDPRO growth below 0.5% year-over-year), S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% YoY, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the past six months indicates strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS increases over the prior six months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a labor market recovery (unemployment rate falling below 4.0% for two consecutive months), S&P 500 forward returns become positive over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and corporate hiring.
regime_hint: unemployment rate below 4.0% for two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial output that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.
